tasks.short: Collect genuine survey evidence and consolidate responses

steps.what: Conduct surveys and collect responses or documentary observations
Consolidate collected data into the study response dataset
Check collected data completeness and resolve collection discrepancies

tasks.design: Keep interviews, focus groups and evidence gathering human while using native export mappings in survey-collection {OTHER} for repeated consolidation. Only already captured structured records flow automatically to a staging dataset; ambiguous documents and collection discrepancies remain with the researcher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Responses from several collection routes need repeated consolidation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form exports and fixed import mappings can move captured fields without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Nonresponse, ambiguous answers and preserving the meaning of documentary evidence.
tasks.human_edge: Obtain genuine responses and recognise unreliable or misunderstood evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less data transfer, with collection and quality decisions retained.

evidence.claim: Native response exports and deterministic consolidation can reduce repeated data transfer; the task-level saving is an unmeasured mixed-method scenario.

assumptions: Boundary includes collecting and consolidating evidence, excluding instrument design, systematic coding and statistical reporting allocated separately.

OTHER means survey-collection software. Respondents supply genuine answers during s1; researcher captures study identifier, response identifier, instrument version, item identifiers, raw answers, missingness, collection mode, timestamp and permitted-use status in s1's 70 hours. Documentary or interview evidence requiring transcription is manually captured there. Missing or ambiguous fields bypass automatic transfer and are resolved in s3.
Test native exports and fixed import profiles before custom code. Existing questionnaire capture runtime receives no new saving, and participant time remains unchanged outside the focal denominator.
The 15-hour consolidation baseline applies only where the researcher currently repeats transfers; already integrated studies have zero transfer saving. No synthetic respondents are used.
research_questions: Does fixed consolidation remove transfer effort after capture, discrepancy checking and mapping upkeep?

already_counted.description: Resolve collection discrepancies and check consolidated responses

incremental.description: Maintain export profiles and test changed instruments

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70+0+15=85, gross=15, upkeep=4, net=11. Range 0-5 allows interview-heavy collection and studies with existing integration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare verified survey tables, graphs and findings summaries

steps.what: Specify survey analyses, denominators and disclosure rules for the report
Prepare survey tables, graphs and fact sheets using specified calculations
Interpret and present survey summaries after checking the methods and results

tasks.design: Configure native statistical tables and linked chart templates in {SPREADSHEET} and {BI} before custom reporting code. The researcher specifies the analysis and disclosure rules, checks the rendered results and writes or presents the interpretation personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated calculations and chart copying create avoidable report preparation work.
tasks.enabler_now: Parameterised native report templates can rerun fixed calculations without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Weighting choices, nonresponse bias and explaining what the sample cannot establish.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish an accurate calculation from an unjustified conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated report production leaves more time for interpretation and limitations.

evidence.claim: Fixed statistical formulas and parameterised report templates can generate tables and graphs; the proposed labour saving requires local measurement.

assumptions: Boundary starts with a checked response dataset and ends with verified presentation. Collection and substantive data cleaning are allocated separately and receive no duplicate saving.

Survey researcher supplies dataset version, item definitions, missing-value codes, strata and cluster fields if relevant, weight version, requested statistics, subgroup definitions, denominators, uncertainty method and suppression thresholds in s1's 30 hours. The same researcher's collection process produces the checked response dataset before this task. Missing analysis metadata blocks generation and returns to manual specification or calculation within s3.
Native tables and linked charts are tested before custom code. Existing automatic calculation runtime earns no new saving; the scenario requires repeated manual production today.
No generated causal explanation or automatic public release is included. Additional methodological work is not hidden inside the machine step.
unknowns: Dataset readiness and actual reporting repetition
research_questions: Do native report templates save production time after full statistical and disclosure checking?

already_counted.description: Check rendered outputs, resolve calculation exceptions and present limitations

incremental.description: Maintain statistical templates, suppression tests and changed-variable mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact report snapshot bound to dataset, weights, analysis specification, suppression rules and chart versions; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+0+30=60, gross=40, upkeep=8, net=32. Range 0-20 allows complex methods, extensive disclosure checks and already automated tables.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult clients about survey needs and special requirements

steps.what: Consult with clients to clarify survey needs and special sample requirements

tasks.design: Retain client consultation with the researcher, using {DOCS} for existing context if helpful. Understanding the decision and challenging an unsuitable sample request require dialogue; no separate clerical baseline is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clients often express a requested output before the underlying decision is clear.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated tool removes the clarification and agreement work.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling desired precision, sample access, budget and feasible conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an impossible or misleading research request and explain alternatives.
tasks.altitude: Client consultation remains the researcher's responsibility.

evidence.claim: Client needs clarification remains human conversation work; no local saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is consultation, excluding later project specification and instrument development assigned separately.
No inferred client consent, machine sample requirement or automatic scope agreement is introduced; client effort is unchanged.
Native access to prior briefs continues without new configuration or runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because the workflow does not change.
unknowns: Client decision context and sampling constraints
research_questions: Is a separate recordkeeping burden present outside the consultation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Needs clarification remains human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Specify survey project methods, sources and instruments

steps.what: Determine survey sources, procedures and instrument design from the research objectives

tasks.design: Keep methodological specification with the researcher using {DOCS}. Existing instrument templates can inform the design, but source choice, procedures and question validity still require judgement and testing.
tasks.previous_blocker: A syntactically valid questionnaire can still measure the wrong construct.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated new capability removes this methodological design work.
tasks.still_hard: Coverage error, question interpretation and feasible sampling procedures.
tasks.human_edge: Connect research objectives to a defensible measurement strategy.
tasks.altitude: The researcher retains methodological decision rights.

evidence.claim: Survey methodological specification remains judgement work; no task-level saving is established by generating plausible questions.

assumptions: Boundary is methodological specification, excluding client consultation, instrument programming, data collection and statistical reporting allocated separately.
No automatic methodological acceptance or synthetic pilot response is introduced. Existing human testing of question meaning remains required.
Native instrument templates are considered before new software and receive no new runtime-saving credit.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is proposed.
unknowns: Study objectives and required methodological testing
research_questions: Is there a distinct instrument-programming burden separable from methodological design?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Methodological specification remains human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The researcher retains client and methodological judgement while reducing selected response-transfer and fixed report-production effort.
reach: Explain sampling uncertainty and survey-derived indicators
role.ambitious_version: A survey researcher who spends less time moving and formatting data and more time defending the validity of the study.
